shown_passages.text: New or worsening shortness of breath at rest, or waking at night gasping for air, is a heart-failure danger sign requiring urgent care.
Weight gain of more than 2 kg (about 4-5 lb) in 2 to 3 days can signal fluid buildup in heart failure and needs urgent clinician contact.
Increasing swelling of the ankles, legs, or abdomen indicates worsening fluid retention and should be reported promptly.
Furosemide is a loop diuretic used to remove excess fluid in heart failure. Take it in the morning to avoid nighttime urination; report muscle cramps or excessive thirst.
Lisinopril is an ACE inhibitor that lowers blood pressure and reduces strain on the heart. A dry cough or dizziness can occur; do not stop without advice.
Follow any fluid-intake limit set by your care team.
Limiting dietary sodium (salt) helps prevent fluid buildup.
Weigh yourself each morning after using the bathroom and before breakfast.
Chest pain or pressure, especially with sweating or nausea, may indicate a cardiac emergency; call emergency services immediately.
Severe dizziness, lightheadedness, or fainting can reflect dangerously low blood pressure or an abnormal heart rhythm and needs urgent evaluation.
New confusion, marked fatigue, or reduced alertness can be a sign of poor heart output and warrants urgent medical attention.

prompts.system:
You are a clinical aftercare assistant. You may ONLY state facts present in the provided CONTEXT passages. Every claim MUST cite its guideline_id. Return JSON matching the schema and nothing else. `danger_signs` must include EVERY danger-sign passage present in the context and must never be empty. `lifestyle` must include EVERY lifestyle passage present in the context. Include every medication passage that matches the patient's listed medications, preserving any timing or caution in that passage. Do NOT add any medication that is not in the patient's listed medications. If a fact is not in the context, omit it. This is assistive and defers to the care team.

OUTPUT CONTRACT: Return exactly one JSON object and no Markdown. It must have arrays named danger_signs, medications, and lifestyle. Each danger sign/lifestyle item must contain text and guideline_id; each medication item must contain drug, instruction, and guideline_id. Use an empty string for guideline_id when no source is cited. Use [] for a section with no applicable items.
